description: Create a checkout link a HUMAN pays from their own Algorand wallet (Pera). Use this when you have no wallet, or when the person should approve and pay themselves: they open the link, see the exact price, sign in their wallet, and the result (the eSIM QR code, or the top-up confirmation) appears on the page. You never hold a key. A top-up link can be paid by anyone — send it to family as 'top up my phone'. An eSIM link delivers to whoever pays. Free. Add `ref` (your Algorand address) to earn a share of margin on each delivered order.

amount.description: for range top-up offers: amount in local currency

max_uses.description: 0 = reusable until expiry; default 1 for topup, 0 for esim

note.description: shown on the link page, e.g. 'Your Tokyo trip data'

ref.description: your Algorand address, to earn referral share

name: create_pay_link
